summary: The fail-open hole closes where a shell exists: unresolvable interpreters now exit 2 (blocking) at the single resolution point, with the outer sh guard doubling the closure; the launcher itself is CRLF-pinned so a Windows checkout cannot corrupt the resolver; doctor turns silent breakage into named red rows and the windows CI job proves the armed lockout on the platform that exposed the hole. Verified live post-change: the session lockout denied a product write under the new hook path. Honest limit stands as specced: no shell at all still means no self-arming - detection is the net until WIN-2 installs prerequisites.
residual_risks: Fail-open without any POSIX shell (AC-stated); WIN-2 owns remediation.
Workers still run danger-full-access until WIN-SBX flips the vendored default.
